propositions: Record the CLI command registry design as ADR 0100, capturing the approved architecture: stdlib-only immutable lazy registry with parser-factory references, deterministic help generation from argparse factories, pre-operation routing/alias/capability enforcement, and explicit non-goals including no plugin framework or Click dependency.

Establish argparse factories as the single grammar source for both runtime parsing and authoritative generated help, enforcing same-source migration per command family with no docs-only syntax authority.

Document the semantic capability registry with error/unavailable/abstain/fallback postures and pre-RP-04-boundary routing that precedes operation-snapshot composition, config materialization, store mount, and optional imports.

Define canonical/exact/compatibility/hidden/retired alias taxonomy with shared argument-definition helpers, preserving bridge-setup jira-onboard spelling per ADR 0070 and maintaining parity through expand/contract migration.

Generate ADR 0100 and update docs/architecture.md with implemented boundaries, verify numbering bijection and index generation, and gate submission on maintainer approval and both Gerrit checks passing.
